title: Building community at HKUST
description: Joining the MSBA Student Committee for 2026/27 as Director of Operations, and turning ideas into meaningful initiatives.
paragraphs: Honoured to be part of the The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology MSBA Student Committee for 2026/27 as Director of Operations!

A big thank you to the HKUST MSc in Business Analytics program and specifically to Prof. Lancelot F. James, Prof. Lucy XIA, Prof. Carlos Fernández-Loría, Prof. Joon Nak Choi and Mrs. Marcela Barrios León, for the support and trust in our team. I'm excited to work alongside such a diverse group of people, bringing different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives together to make this year a memorable one for our community.

Most importantly, thank you to my fellow committee members Elias Hausmann, Ruby Ding, Lanxi Feng, Indra Enkh and Léo-Jun Lille. Looking forward to working with all of you, exchanging ideas, and turning them into meaningful initiatives for our students.

To all current and future MSBA students, please feel free to reach out to any of us whenever you need support, have an idea to share, or simply want to get involved. We’re here to help make the MSBA experience better for everyone.
Looking forward to the year ahead!
